title: BBC Sci-Fi Radio Plays
paragraphs: A library collection of BBC science-fiction dramatizations, ranging from classic literary adaptations to original radio plays. It is a compilation rather than one continuous BBC series.

Curated audio-drama compilation rather than one continuous historical BBC series. The 43 frozen objects mix standalone radio plays, serialized parts, compiled serials and a 14-track 2016 Audible drama.

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Dirk Maggs (radio adaptor and director), Tim Lebbon (author), Michael Patrick (writer), Michael Shannon (producer), Oisín Kearney (writer), Simon Barnard (director and producer), and Daphne du Maurier (author).

The stories often return to science-fiction and speculative audio-drama collection, extraterrestrial life and alien threat, time distortion and altered reality, dystopia and social control, paranormal or uncanny phenomena, and espionage and secret-agent adventure.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes BBC tradition of literary science-fiction adaptation, Radio drama into podcast and digital-audio distribution, and Mixed-provenance digital archive.
